description: Backs the higher-ranked side (by Sep 16 Global VRS snapshot) in every Finals match at the best verified price available, flat 25 units per bet.
rules: Eligible: every TWC 2026 Finals match with a verified moneyline/match-winner price.
Pick: team with the better (lower) Sep-16 Global VRS rank; ties = no bet.
Stake: flat 25.00 units. Max one position per match.
Price: must be captured with ticker/market id + observed_utc before first map starts; otherwise no bet.
Settlement: per market rule + HLTV/Liquipedia result cross-check.
notes: Policy published, not live: match bets require independently verified Finals fixtures, pre-start asks with depth, and a tested match-strategy engine. No inferred/backdated positions.

description: Bets only when the market price implies a win chance at least 8 points below a VRS-gap heuristic: favorite fair = 50% + 2.5% per VRS-rank gap (capped 85%). Stakes 20 units.
rules: Fair(favorite) = min(85%, 50% + 2.5% * (underdog_vrs - favorite_vrs)). Fair(underdog) = 1 - fair(favorite).
Bet the side whose market-implied probability is >= 8.0 points below its fair value.
Implied probability from decimal odds = 1 / decimal_odds; from prediction shares = share price.
Stake: flat 20.00 units. Max one position per match; no bet if neither side clears the edge bar.
Price + settlement rules identical to sim_favorite_backer.
notes: Policy published, not live: match bets require independently verified Finals fixtures, pre-start asks with depth, and a tested match-strategy engine. No inferred/backdated positions.

description: Outright-only paper strategy: if BOTH teams have fresh first-party best asks with enough top-of-book size in the same pre-Finals collection run, records 50 simulated units on FURIA and Falcons. Gross P/L; no real execution, fees or slippage modeled.
rules: Eligible: tournament-winner contracts explicitly tied to Thunderpick World Championship 2026, NOT qualifier/series or map/match markets.

In the same live collection run before Oct 14 UTC, require BOTH FURIA and Falcons Yes outcomes: exchange book timestamps <= 10 minutes old, quote receipts <= 2 minutes before decision and <= 60 seconds apart, top-of-book size >= stake / ask.
Pick the lowest eligible ask for each team (market ID breaks ties); stake 50.00 units each, atomically. If either side is unavailable, place neither.
Capture the raw ask, ask size, quote ID, venue, market ID, settlement rule and decision timestamp. No inference of a real fill; fees/slippage excluded.
One pair maximum, never backdated. Settlements are held pending until venue resolution and the winner are independently cross-checked.
notes: This is the only price-dependent strategy currently implemented. It will remain empty unless both verified quotes appear in the same future live run.
